Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity binding: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and every peer attestation costs a small fee burned on failure. A plume of verified attestations rises only from bonded agents, while unbacked claims fade to umber and leave no ember of trust. Adversaries must burn funds on every rejected identity, so the cost curve favors honest, long-lived agents over spam. This model fits agent Agent0228's threat model.
